prompt:
Subject:
Red pen by the bookshelf.

Main Subject:
A young woman standing in front of bookshelves in a sunlit library is the main subject in the center of the frame. Lavender lace top and bottom, draped pale pink long shirt, black round glasses, red pen in left hand are the main elements.

Character & Expression:
Thin oval face, small chin, light brown eyes behind black round glasses, thin eyebrows, well-defined nose, glossy pale pink lips. Head tilted slightly to right, gaze meeting front camera with modest smile. Bright brown shoulder-length wavy hair with thin bangs and strands along face.

Clothing & Pose:
Light lavender floral lace-trimmed bra top and matching shorts with small central ribbon. Pale pink long-sleeved button shirt worn open over it, sleeves rolled up to elbows. Left arm bent sideways holding red pen upright, right arm extended downwards bringing fingertips close to bookshelf, left leg crossed forward.

Background & Light:
Tall wooden bookshelves filled with books on right, desk and blue chair in left background, dark green wainscoting, large window at top. Hard daylight shines diagonally from top-left window onto hair, shoulders, chest, and legs, creating bright shadows on floor and desk.

Composition & Camera:
2:3 vertical composition, frontal camera at waist height capturing three-quarter portrait from head to below thighs. Person placed largely in center, bookshelf on right half, red pen at top left. Legs cropped at bottom, focus on eyes and glasses, bookshelves slightly blurred.

Texture & Style:
Photorealistic live-action photo. High definition natural skin, lace, thin shirt, black glasses, red pen, wood and book spines, bright daylight in lavender, pale pink, and wood tones.

Negative:
Omission of glasses and red pen; changes to lavender top/bottom or bookshelf arrangement
